response.sql: WITH filtered_standings AS (SELECT driverId, points, wins FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1.0), driver_averages AS (SELECT driverId, AVG(points) as avg_points, AVG(wins) as avg_wins FROM filtered_standings GROUP BY driverId), overall_mean_wins AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as mean_wins FROM driver_averages WHERE avg_wins IS NOT NULL) SELECT da.driverId, da.avg_points, da.avg_wins, da.avg_wins - omw.mean_wins as difference FROM driver_averages da CROSS JOIN overall_mean_wins omw WHERE omw.mean_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10
